lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Heya, Rookie,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: what are you doing?
Waiting in line for the flash sale at Talentum Mall.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Is that today?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I almost forgot.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: You should have mentioned it to me.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Look at you, waiting in line just like the others.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Such a man of the people.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Anything you've got your eye on?
Some underwear.
An electric toothbrush.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Hehehe... Well...

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I certainly appreciate your honesty.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Interesting!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I didn't expect you to

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: care so much about your oral hygiene.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: You have such white teeth already, so

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I don't think you need to brush them too much.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Anything else strike your fancy?
Hm... not really.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: No problem.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Just think it over

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: and give me a list of what you want to buy.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: If we've got it in stock, I'll set some aside for you.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Touched?
You don't have to do me any favors.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Huh? Why not?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Aren't you waiting for the flash sale?
I'd prefer to shop regularly like everyone else.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Well, well, look at you!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: If you ask me, you're a real sucker!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Fine then, if you insist, I won't do anything for you.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: But don't come crying to me later

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: since you're the one who declined my offer.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Oh, right!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: While you were busy chatting with me,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: the flash sale has already ended.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: The entire mall's been picked clean. Well, toodles!
Yan!
Yan doesn't reply to any other messages I send.
